title: Statue of Liberty [and] New York Harbor
notes: Round 9 (2026-10-29), map resource for the arrival place (New York Harbor, ALB-F-0183). Library of Congress item record.

claim: Madeleine Albright's first trans-Atlantic crossing was on the SS America.

evidence.quote: You know, from that first trans-Atlantic crossing on the SS America, to landing in nations around the world in that big blue-and-white plane emblazoned with the words “United States of America,” Madeleine understood her story was America’s story.
evidence.locator: President Biden's remarks, paragraph on her travels

notes: Round 9 (globe-to-map, 2026-10-29): the ship of her first crossing, from a record already on file (ALB-S-0154, NARA-held Biden White House remarks at her funeral, primary by the registry rule). Corroborates the ship in ALB-F-0185 (Bush Center, secondary, 'aboard the SS America in 1948'); no year or port is claimed. Port of departure not found in any registered source (searches round9-2026-10-29).
